params.name: league.knowledge.scale.max
params.constrainedBy: Knowledge is 0 to 100 (D9.1.1); also converts points to a fraction

params.name: league.knowledge.items.conceptOverFamilyMax
params.constrainedBy: A concept cannot exceed family knowledge by more than 20. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.items.difficultyMin
params.constrainedBy: Difficulty per position is rated 1 to 5

params.name: league.knowledge.items.difficultyMax
params.constrainedBy: Difficulty per position is rated 1 to 5

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.base.meeting
params.constrainedBy: Per 5 minutes on the item. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it; tuning target: starters reach 80 by game day on a normal week

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.base.film
params.constrainedBy: Per 5 minutes on the item. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.base.walkthrough
params.constrainedBy: Per walk-through rep. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.base.fullSpeed
params.constrainedBy: Per full-speed rep. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.base.gameSnap
params.constrainedBy: Per game snap. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.minutesPerUnit
params.constrainedBy: Meeting and film bases are per 5 minutes on the item

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.crowdingDivisor
params.constrainedBy: Crowding = 1 + (new items this week / 12)^2. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.cap.meeting
params.constrainedBy: Meetings and film alone cannot pass 60. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.cap.walkthrough
params.constrainedBy: Walk-through raises the cap to 80. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.cap.fullSpeed
params.constrainedBy: Only full-speed reps and game snaps reach 100

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.teacherMin
params.constrainedBy: Teacher factor 0.85 to 1.15; Assumption with no source (research R33)

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.teacherMax
params.constrainedBy: Teacher factor 0.85 to 1.15; Assumption with no source (research R33)

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.attentionMinutes
params.constrainedBy: Attention falls after 45 minutes in one meeting (starting value, Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.attentionAfter
params.constrainedBy: G5.1.2 says attention falls after 45 minutes but gives no size; 0.5 per minute past it is the module author's choice

params.name: league.knowledge.gain.campRelearn
params.constrainedBy: Camp gain is double the usual gain below the previous peak. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.decay.weeklyRate
params.constrainedBy: 1.5 percent per week without a rep or review; acceptance: 90 unused 8 weeks falls to about 80

params.name: league.knowledge.decay.floorConcept
params.constrainedBy: Floor is 60 percent of peak for concepts and variations. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.decay.floorFamily
params.constrainedBy: Floor is 85 percent of peak for families. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.decay.reviewRestore
params.constrainedBy: A review rep or 5 meeting minutes resets the timer and restores up to 5 points

params.name: league.knowledge.decay.reviewMinutes
params.constrainedBy: 5 minutes of meeting time counts as a review

params.name: league.knowledge.carry.relatedMin
params.constrainedBy: Related family similarity 0.5 to 0.8. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.carry.relatedMax
params.constrainedBy: Related family similarity 0.5 to 0.8. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.carry.conceptBelowFamily
params.constrainedBy: Concepts start at family level minus 20. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.carry.formerOpponentShare
params.constrainedBy: A former opponent's debrief gives half the normal scout-team preparation; Assumption, practice Unverified

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.e
params.constrainedBy: e x (1 - k/100)^2; acceptance: 100, 80, 60, 40 give 0, 2, 8, 18 percent

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.difficultyFactorMin
params.constrainedBy: Difficulty factor 0.6 to 1.6; mapped linearly from difficulty 1 to 5 (mapping is the module author's reading)

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.difficultyFactorMax
params.constrainedBy: Difficulty factor 0.6 to 1.6

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.lineChange
params.constrainedBy: x1.3 if the item was changed at the line. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.delayBelow
params.constrainedBy: Knowledge under 80 adds processing delay

params.name: league.knowledge.errors.delayPerPoint
params.constrainedBy: (80 - k) x 0.01 s added to first reaction. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.s.ol
params.constrainedBy: S for line pairs. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.s.qbReceiver
params.constrainedBy: S for quarterback and receiver. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.s.secondary
params.constrainedBy: S for secondary pairs. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.s.qbCenter
params.constrainedBy: S for quarterback and center. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.gameWeight
params.constrainedBy: Game snaps count 1.0

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.practiceWeight
params.constrainedBy: Full-speed practice reps count 0.6. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.decaySeason
params.constrainedBy: 10 percent per season apart. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.decayWeek
params.constrainedBy: 2 percent per in-season week not together. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.cap.stunt
params.constrainedBy: Stunt and twist pickup +0 to +8 percent. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.cap.combo
params.constrainedBy: Combination block timing +0 to +5 percent. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.cap.timing
params.constrainedBy: Timing-route completion +0 to +3 points. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.optionAgreeLow
params.constrainedBy: Option-route agreement 80 percent at cohesion 0. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.optionAgreeHigh
params.constrainedBy: Option-route agreement 98 percent at cohesion 100. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.cohesion.cap.passOff
params.constrainedBy: Coverage pass-off errors -0 to -30 percent of base. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.readiness.flagBelow
params.constrainedBy: Players below 70 on anything slated are listed; late scratch flags calls below 70

params.name: league.knowledge.readiness.gapWeight
params.constrainedBy: Play readiness = mean minus half the gap between mean and lowest (starting formula)

params.name: league.knowledge.readiness.recognitionMax
params.constrainedBy: Opponent preparation gives the D4.1.1 recognition bonus up to 20 percent. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.readiness.rivalKeep
params.constrainedBy: Division or conference opponents keep 30 percent of preparation. Assumption (design tuning) per the leaf; no source measures it

params.name: league.knowledge.install.threshold
params.constrainedBy: Installed means knowledge 60 (starting threshold)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.dailyLimit
params.constrainedBy: 12 learning units per position group per day (Assumption); research F14.5.1 rows give 3 to 5 concepts a day (AJ) and three or four (AL), each 1 of 3

params.name: league.knowledge.install.overLimitYield
params.constrainedBy: G5.2.1 says yield per unit falls sharply over the limit and gives no size; 0.25 is the module author's choice

params.name: league.knowledge.install.minRepsCarry
params.constrainedBy: Every sheet call gets at least one rep against a relevant look (starting value)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.minRepsNew
params.constrainedBy: New items three or more reps (starting value)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.alwaysUpShare
params.constrainedBy: The always-up set gets 20 percent of weekly reps (starting value)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.fadingDrop
params.constrainedBy: Fading when estimated knowledge falls 10 below the installed threshold (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.catchUpCap
params.constrainedBy: A newly signed player's first-week package caps at 15 plays (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.backupQbShare
params.constrainedBy: Default backup quarterback share of first-team reps 5 percent (follows the sourced practice in G5.5.1)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.backupQbShareMax
params.constrainedBy: User may set 0 to 50 percent (Assumption on the bounds)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.extraMeetingMinutes
params.constrainedBy: Extra position meetings cost the position coach 30 minutes each (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.camp.installs
params.constrainedBy: Base system split into about three installs (research F14.5.1 AK, 1 of 3; count an Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.camp.daysPerInstall
params.constrainedBy: Each install taught over about three days (research AK; Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.install.camp.passes
params.constrainedBy: The whole cycle repeated about three times (research AK, 1 of 3; Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.sdStart
params.constrainedBy: Estimate error sd 20 for a player unseen in this scheme (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.sdPerRep
params.constrainedBy: Falls 2 per observed practice rep (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.sdFloor
params.constrainedBy: Floor of 6 from reps (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.sdTested
params.constrainedBy: Falls to 4 after a written test or teach-back (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.coachLow
params.constrainedBy: x1.5 for a low-skill position coach (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.coachHigh
params.constrainedBy: x0.7 for a high-skill position coach (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.optimistBiasMin
params.constrainedBy: Optimistic position coach bias +5 to +10 (Assumption)

params.name: league.knowledge.estimate.optimistBiasMax
params.constrainedBy: Optimistic position coach bias +5 to +10 (Assumption)
